attack_techniques: Steal or Forge Kerberos Tickets: AS-REP Roasting (T1558.004)
attackers_goals: Crack account credentials by obtaining an easy-to-crack Kerberos ticket.
description: A user enumerated all accounts that don't require pre-authentication in the organization and specifically requested tickets for those accounts. This is typically a sign of an AS-REP Roasting attack.
investigative_actions: Check who used the host at the time of the alert, to rule out a benign service or tool requesting weak Kerberos encryption.
name: Possible AS-REP Roasting Attack
required_data: XDR AgentXDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
